## Coursework Overview

This portfolio presents seven hands-on geospatial analytics chapters completed with R and Quarto. The work starts from spatial data import and coordinate systems, moves into choropleth mapping, develops first-order and second-order spatial point pattern analysis for Singapore childcare centre locations, extends point pattern thinking into a spatio-temporal fire case study, and applies spatial weights and global autocorrelation statistics to county-level development data.

I designed the site so each chapter can be read as a self-contained workflow: the code is visible, the maps are rendered in the page, and short observations are included after key outputs.
